title.narrative: Gas and Oil Capacity Building Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Gas and Oil Capacity Building Project is to improve the public management and regulatory capacity while enhancing transparency; and strengthen local technical skills in Ghana's emerging oil and gas sector. There are three components to the project. The first component of the project is institutional development and sector management. This component has five sub-components: 1) diverse support to the Ministry of energy and the future regulatory body, including in media and communications; 2) expansion and revamping of the Ghana National Petroleum Corporation (GNPC) data repository to safeguard the oil and gas data being generated through exploration and well development; 3) support to the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), support to the Ministry of finance and economic planning; and 4) support to the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) secretariat. The second component of the project is education and skills development. This component has two sub-components: a) vocational training support; and b) tertiary education and research support. The third component of the project supports the Project Coordination Unit (PCU) in its role of coordinator and manager of the project. It will enhance the PCU's capacity for procurement. It is envisaged that the PCU will also be the focal point for capacity building assistance in the petroleum sector provided by other donors in the future.
The project objective is to (i) improve public management and regulatory capacity while enhancing transparency; and (ii) strengthen local technical skills in Ghana's emerging oil and gas sector.

title.narrative: Regular supply of communication from public sector on oil and gas issues, as measured by: number of unique visitors per month on MoE website

comment.narrative: This intermediate indicator was introduced when the project was restructured in 2014. It replaced one of the original intermediate indicators that sought to measure the regular supply of communication from the public sector to public officials and citizens on oil and gas issues measured by the increase in hits on the official Ministry of Energy website (the original target was for a 50% increse). In the end, the outcome was achieved thanks to a higher than expected number of unique visitors per month on the Ministry of Energy's website.

comment.narrative: While there is lack of clarity as to what courses were being offered by RMU at project close, TTI and KTI offered courses in technical training for the oil and gas sector (mechanical, welding and fabrication).

title.narrative: KNUST capacity for providing high-level degree programs in petroleum engineering and petrochemical engineering strengthened

baseline.value: Zero students in Petroleum Engineering at KNUST trained using petroleum laboratory.

target.value: 294 students completed training in Petroleum Engineering and in Petrochemical Engineering. 33 staff attended training out of which 7 attended MSc degrees and 4 PhD degrees. Construction and equipment of nine laboratories for: fluids; a core and rock; research; drilling simulator; drilling fluids and cementing; reservoir simulation; unit operations I&II; process development; and instrumentation.

comment.narrative: The outcome was achieved, even if the target number of trained students was not met.

actual.value: 300 students at KNUST completed training in petroleum engineering and petrochemical engineering taught by faculty trained under theproject and in laboratories funded by the project.

title.narrative: KTI, TTI and RMU capacity strengthened for enhancing the skills of the local workforce to engage in the oil and gas sector.

baseline.value: Zero students successfully completing skills training programs, incl. health and safety courses initiated by KTI, TTI, and RMU.

target.value: 238 students at KTI and TTI completed courses in CBT mechanical, welding and fabrication. 85 KTI, TTI and RMU staff trained. KTI: construction/refurbishment concluded and equipment installed and working at new mechanical workshop, welding and fabrication workshop, electrical laboratory, electronics laboratory, and hydraulics workshop. TTI: construction/refurbishment concluded and equipment installed and working at new well control simulator laboratory, drilling fluid laboratory, mechanical workshop, welding and fabrication workshop, electrical laboratory, electronics laboratory, and hydraulics workshop. RMU: construction/refurbishment concluded and equipment installed and working at new well control simulator laboratory, process operator simulator laboratory, drilling fluid laboratory, mechanical workshop, welding and fabrication workshop, electrical laboratory, electronics laboratory, crane operations simulator laboratory, and hydraulics workshop.

comment.narrative: The outcome was only partially achieved due to the delays in the construction/installation of the various laboratories and the design of the CBT curricula, which delayed the enrollment of students.

actual.value: 530 students at KTI, TTI and RMU completed courses in CBT curriculum and in labs/workshops funded by the project in skills relevantto the oil and gas sector.

title.narrative: EPA is equipped and its capacity strengthened for conducting marine and shoreline work in proximity of oil and gas operations

baseline.value: No staff trained to monitor and regulate the oil and gas sector.

target.value: EPA is equipped and its capacity strengthened for conducting marine and shoreline work in the proximity of oil and gas operations; marine vessel is operationalized, 28 EPA staff trained, signing on to the services of the Oil Spill Response Limited (OSRL) for 2017and EPA Analytical Laboratory in EPA's Western Region Office installed.

comment.narrative: The outcome was partially achieved. 28 out of the original target of 30 EPA staff received training. More significantly, the Analytical Laboratory at the EPA's Western Region 's Offices was installed but it has yet to come into operation due to delays in securing accreditation, among others.

actual.value: EPA is equipped and its capacity strengthened for conducting marine and shoreline work in the proximity of oil and gas operations; marine vessel is procured, 30 EPA staff trained, signing on to the services of the Oil Spill Response Limited (OSRL) and EPA Analytical Laboratory in EPA's Western Region Office installed/in operation.
